purpose: Make Constitutional Capitalism capable of moving through time, shocks, and measurement — without inventing more policy. Establish the temporal spine of the book, the Dependency Rule, and homes for baseline, sequencing, resilience, household/geographic measurement, intergenerational/population capital, and expansion/correction.

dependency_rule.statement: No existing revenue source, benefit, public service, obligation, or economic institution is removed merely because Constitutional Capitalism proposes a superior replacement. The replacement must first demonstrate the capacity to assume the existing function.
dependency_rule.one_line: Build the bridge before removing the old road.
dependency_rule.prevents: utopian abolish-today sequencing that collapses services, markets, or household security

arkansas_transition_map.rule: Bones and structural purposes only — not every Year-4 program.

sequence.label: Arkansas NOW
sequence.structural_purpose: Establish baseline and inherited obligations — fiscal, institutional, demographic, household, and place realities we start from.
sequence.not: A complete policy redesign of today

sequence.label: Years 1–2
sequence.structural_purpose: Establish measurement, legal foundations, pilots, institutional capacity, and initial productive assets.

sequence.label: Years 3–5
sequence.structural_purpose: Begin scaling proven mechanisms and carefully replacing existing structures only where prerequisites have been satisfied.

sequence.label: Years 6–10
sequence.structural_purpose: Move from isolated reforms toward an integrated political-economic operating system.
sequence.not: Claim that the system is finished

sequence.label: Generation 1
sequence.structural_purpose: Demonstrate whether Constitutional Capitalism actually creates greater household and public wealth.
sequence.not: Narrative victory without measured household surplus

sequence.label: Generation 2
sequence.structural_purpose: Test the central promise: whether Arkansans inherit a stronger productive system than the previous generation received.

arkansas_transition_map.chain_display: ARKANSAS NOW → YEARS 1–2 → YEARS 3–5 → YEARS 6–10 → GENERATION 1 → GENERATION 2
